simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שַׁחַץ (H7830) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שַׁחַץ (shachats) means haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude) First listed occurrence: Job 28 8.

definitions.full: H7830. shachats [ שַׁ֫חַץ ] noun [masculine] dignity, pride ; — בְּנֵיהֿשָּׁ֑חַץ i.e. majestic wild beasts Job 28:8 (|| שָׁ֑חַל ), 41:26 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut ;
